description: Database schema from a large SQL dump, a CSV/TSV file or a MongoDB JSON export: a readable Markdown description with an ER diagram, a schema designer generating only the changes (ALTER / mongosh script) for the chosen database (PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, Oracle, SQL Server, MongoDB), and click-together SELECT queries. All local, no network.
command.describe.title: Describe a database schema
command.design.title: Schema designer (changes and queries)
command.compareSchema.title: Compare schema with the tree version (impact report)
config.modelFolder.description: Workspace-relative folder for the model: the Markdown description, the full CREATE script and the `.schema.json` file. Empty (default) = `<project>-spec/db/model`.
config.migrationFolder.description: Workspace-relative folder for change scripts from the designer. Empty (default) = `<project>-spec/db/migration`.
